description.en: Window close behaviour and child windows for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的窗口关闭行为与多窗口。

description.en: Close confirmation for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: minimise to tray or quit, remember the choice, change it in Settings, and open a session or workspace in its own window.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端关闭确认：最小化到后台或完全退出，可记住选择并在设置中修改，也可把会话或工作区开进独立窗口。
